llm.summary: This is a prompt-only weekly report generator; its main risk is that users may paste sensitive work details, but the package discloses this risk in the README and contains no executable behavior.

dimensions.detail: A natural-language prompt template is proportionate for generating weekly reports; it does not request filesystem, network, credential, account, or mutation authority.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown files only and no executable scripts or dependencies in the published artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is primarily Chinese and does not include the README's privacy warning inside the prompt users are told to paste, but the instructions stay focused on report generation and do not attempt role override, hidden tool use, or unrelated data collection.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, memory write, privilege escalation, or automatic local storage is present; README mentions optional system-prompt use and historical report reuse as user-directed workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's behavior is coherent with its purpose: it asks for role, work completed, blockers, plans, metrics, and reporting audience to produce weekly report templates for business roles, including potentially sensitive HR, sales, finance, and project contexts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before using it, avoid pasting secrets, customer names, HR records, exact financial figures, source code, or other confidential internal details unless your organization permits that AI tool. Prefer anonymized names and approximate or redacted figures.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language prompt and examples are coherent for a Chinese weekly-report skill and are a usability/localization note rather than a security concern; README also describes requesting an English version as an output adjustment.
[SQP-2] expected: Requesting detailed work information is expected for weekly report generation. The risk is real because users may include confidential business or personal data, but README includes explicit data-safety guidance and redaction advice; SKILL.md would be improved by repeating that warning directly.
